title: The carrier of a rectifiable current is H^n-null off its support (G2)
statement: Assume the mass formula MF: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_n(U) and every rectifiable triple (M, θ, ξ) in U (IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ) with T(ω) = ∫_M θ ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n (tauAction n M θ ξ ω) for all ω ∈ D^n(U), and every open W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(T) = ∫⁻_{M∩W} θ dH^n (H^n = μHE[n]). Then for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_n(U) and every rectifiable triple (M, θ, ξ) in U with T = τ(M, θ, ξ) on D^n(U), H^n(M ∖ spt T) = 0.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ T.support) = 0
